case_name: Tejumal Bhojwani And Ors vs State Of U.P

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P., through the Collector, [Land Acquisition Officer, Avas Evam Vikas Parishad (hereinafter referred to as 'the Parishad')]

facts_of_case: The appellants were owners of large tract of land. The respondent is the State of U.P. Through the Parishad, a notification was issued under Section 28 of the Adhiniyam for acquiring land for construction of houses. The Land Acquisition Officer gave three different Awards and offered compensation to the claimants. The claimants sought compensation before the Civil Court which enhanced the compensation.

legal_principles.principle: The President may specify the castes, races or tribes which shall be deemed to be Scheduled Castes in relation to a State or Union territory.
legal_principles.held: Article 341 reads thus: '341 SCHEDULED CASTES. (1) The President may with respect to any State or Union territory, and where it is a State after consultation with the Governor thereof, by public notification, specify the castes, races or tribes or parts of or groups within castes, races or tribes or parts of or groups within castes, races or tribes which shall for the purposes of this Constitution be deemed to be Scheduled Castes in relation to that State or Union territory, as the case may be.'

legal_principles.principle: A notification issued under Article 341(1) of the Constitution shall not be varied by any subsequent notification.
legal_principles.held: It is in relation thereto the President has been authorised to limit the notification to parts or groups within the castes. The notification issued in terms of the said provision is exhaustive.

legal_principles.principle: The tribe 'Pasi' finds place in the notification whereas 'Kurmi' does not.
legal_principles.held: The tribe 'Pasi' admittedly finds place in the said notification whereas 'Kurmi' does not.
